title: Loud blasts rock Sanaa as Houthis accuse Saudi forces of pounding Yemeni capital
summary: Houthi rebels accused Saudi forces of launching 26 strikes on Sanaa on Saturday after loud explosions rocked the Yemeni capital, which is controlled by the Iran-backed group. In Saudi Arabia, flames and a large plume of smoke were seen rising from a facility belonging to oil giant Aramco south of the kingdom's capital, Riyadh.
